name: animated-date-picker
title: Animated Date Picker
description: A button that opens a calendar to pick a single date.

props.name: theme
props.label: Theme
props.description: Colour palette, calendar included. The selected day and range take its primary colour.

props.name: mode
props.label: Mode
props.description: Light or dark version of the palette. Starts dark.

props.name: selectionMode
props.label: Selection
props.description: Pick one date, or a start and an end date. A range shows two months side by side from tablet up.

props.name: showIcon
props.label: Icon
props.description: Shows a calendar icon in the trigger button.

props.name: rollingText
props.label: Rolling text
props.description: The button label rolls to a second copy on hover.

props.name: dateFormat
props.label: Format
props.description: How the chosen date is written in the trigger.

props.name: fromBehind
props.label: From behind trigger
props.description: The calendar grows out from behind the trigger instead of appearing below it.

props.name: contentAnimation
props.label: Content animation
props.description: How the calendar appears: scales and fades, or only fades.

props.name: startScale
props.label: Start scale
props.description: Size the calendar starts from when it opens, as a fraction of full size.

props.name: closeOnSelect
props.label: Close on select
props.description: Closes the calendar as soon as a date is picked. For a range, once both ends are picked.

props.name: captionLayout
props.label: Header
props.description: What the calendar header shows: month and year dropdowns, one of them, or a plain label.

props.name: yearsBefore
props.label: Years before
props.description: How many years before this one the year dropdown goes back. Needs a Header with a year dropdown.

props.name: yearsAfter
props.label: Years after
props.description: How many years after this one the year dropdown goes forward. Needs a Header with a year dropdown.

props.name: monthAnimation
props.label: Month animation
props.description: How the days change when you move to another month.

props.name: monthSlideDistance
props.label: Slide distance
props.description: How far the days slide when the month changes, in pixels. Needs Month animation set to Slide + fade.

props.name: slideArrows
props.label: Slide arrows
props.description: The month arrows nudge in the direction they move.

props.name: hoverVariant
props.label: Variant
props.description: Style of the day highlight: filled or outline.

props.name: hoverAnimation
props.label: Hover animation
props.description: How the highlight moves between days: slides or fades.

props.name: hoverDuration
props.label: Glide duration
props.description: How long the highlight takes to glide between days, in seconds.

props.name: hoverBounce
props.label: Glide bounce
props.description: How much the highlight overshoots when gliding. 0 is no bounce.

props.name: weekStartsOn
props.label: Week starts
props.description: First day of the week shown in the calendar.

props.name: onlyCurrentMonth
props.label: Only current month
props.description: Hides days that belong to the previous or next month.

props.name: fixedWeeks
props.label: Fixed 6 weeks
props.description: Always shows six weeks so the calendar keeps the same height.

props.name: disablePast
props.label: Disable past dates
props.description: Greys out dates before today so they can't be picked.

props.name: highlightToday
props.label: Highlight today
props.description: Gives today's date its own highlight.
